---
title: "Assembly of Organelle Genomes"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
# create output directories
outdir_organelle          <- file.path(currentdir, "03_organelle")
outdir_organelle_db       <- file.path(outdir_organelle, "db")
outdir_organelle_assembly <- file.path(outdir_organelle, "01_assembly")

sapply(c(outdir_organelle_db, outdir_organelle_assembly), function(x) {
  if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})

# output files
fn_mtDNA <- file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, "E_phylacis.mito.ctg.fasta")
fn_ptDNA <- file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, "E_phylacis.pltd.ctg.fasta")

# download organelle database
base_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/c-zhou/OatkDB/main/v20230921"
files    <- c("magnoliopsida_mito.fam",
              "magnoliopsida_mito.fam.h3f",
              "magnoliopsida_mito.fam.h3i",
              "magnoliopsida_mito.fam.h3m",
              "magnoliopsida_mito.fam.h3p",
              "magnoliopsida_pltd.fam",
              "magnoliopsida_pltd.fam.h3f",
              "magnoliopsida_pltd.fam.h3i",
              "magnoliopsida_pltd.fam.h3m",
              "magnoliopsida_pltd.fam.h3p")

for (file in files) {
    system(paste("wget",
                 "-q", file.path(base_url, file),
                 "-O", file.path(outdir_organelle_db, file)))
}
```

## OatK

```{r oatk}
# run oatk
if (!all(file.exists(fn_mtDNA, fn_ptDNA)) || params$redo) {
    f_oatk(fn_fastq    = file.path(outdir_hifiasm_corrected_reads, "hifiasm_asm.ec.fq"),
           prefix      = file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, "E_phylacis"),
           fn_ref_mito = file.path(outdir_organelle_db, "magnoliopsida_mito.fam"),
           fn_ref_pltd = file.path(outdir_organelle_db, "magnoliopsida_pltd.fam"),
           thread      = params$thread,
           exe_oatk    = params$exe_oatk)
}
```

```{r extract-nonnuclear}
# combine the two organelle genomes
fn_organelles <- file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, "both_organelles.fasta")
unlink(fn_organelles)

for (organelle in c("pltd", "mito")) {
    seq <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, paste0("E_phylacis.", organelle, ".ctg.fasta")))
    names(seq) <- paste0(organelle, "_", names(seq))
    Biostrings::writeXStringSet(seq, filepath=fn_organelles, append=T)
}

# iterate over haplotypes
for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
    fn_hap <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, paste0("hifiasm_asm.bp.", hap, ".p_ctg.fa"))
    fn_paf <- file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, paste0(hap, "_organelle.paf"))
    fn_out <- file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, paste0(hap, "_organelle.tsv"))

    # align the haplotype assembly to the organelle genomes
    if (!file.exists(fn_paf) || params$redo) {
        f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_organelles,
                       minimap_params = "-cx asm5",
                       fn_query       = fn_hap,
                       fn_out         = fn_paf,
                       thread         = params$thread,
                       exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)
    }

    # open the PAF file
    df_paf <- f_read_paf(fn_paf)

    # filter alignments
    df_paf <- df_paf %>%
                filter(alen >= 5000 & (nmatch / alen) >= 0.98) %>%
                mutate(organelle = substr(tname, 1, 4)) %>%
                group_by(contig = qname) %>%
                summarise(length       = first(qlen),
                          frac_covered = round(f_calculate_merged_len(qstart, qend) / first(qlen), 3),
                          organelle    = paste(sort(unique(organelle)), collapse = ",")) %>%
                arrange(desc(frac_covered))

    data.table::fwrite(df_paf, fn_out, sep="\t")

    # save the list of dropped contigs
    ls_organelle <- df_paf$contig[df_paf$frac_covered >= 0.8]
    writeLines(ls_organelle, con=file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, paste0(hap, "_organelle.txt")))
}
```

## ptDNA validation

```{r mapping, eval=params$run_ptDNA_validation, include=params$run_ptDNA_validation}
# check if metadata file exists
if (!file.exists(params$fn_ptDNA_validation)) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "Input fn_ptDNA_validation is not found. Skipped.")

} else {
    # open the metadata file
    df_metadata <- data.table::fread(params$fn_ptDNA_validation)
    if (!all(c("samples", "r1_dir", "r2_dir") %in% colnames(df_metadata))) {
        log4r::error(fn_logger, "Invalid column names for fn_ptDNA_validation. Skipped.")
    
    } else {
        # create output directory
        outdir_organelle_validation  <- file.path(outdir_organelle, "02_validation")
        outdir_validation_mapping    <- file.path(outdir_organelle_validation, "01_mapping")
        outdir_validation_consensus  <- file.path(outdir_organelle_validation, "02_consensus")
        outdir_validation_tree       <- file.path(outdir_organelle_validation, "03_tree")

        sapply(c(outdir_validation_shortreads, outdir_validation_mapping, outdir_validation_consensus, outdir_validation_tree), function(x) {
            if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})

        # remove the IRa region (which is identical to IRb)
        fn_ptDNA_noIRa <- file.path(outdir_organelle_validation, "E_phylacis.pltd.noIRa.fasta")
        system(paste(params$exe_samtools, "faidx", fn_ptDNA))
        system(paste(params$exe_samtools, "faidx", fn_ptDNA, "ctg000001c:1-134146 >", fn_ptDNA_noIRa))
        system(paste(params$exe_samtools, "faidx", fn_ptDNA_noIRa))

        # create doSNOW clusters
        nwcl <- makeCluster(params$thread)
        registerDoSNOW(nwcl)

        # iterate over sample
        foreach (sample = unique(df_metadata$samples)) %dopar% {
            # subset the data.frame
            df_subset <- df_metadata[df_metadata$samples == sample, ]

            # check if the sample is duplicated
            if (nrow(df_subset) != 1) {
                return (NULL)
            }
            
            # run minimap
            fn_bam <- file.path(outdir_validation_mapping, paste0(sample, ".bam"))

            if (!file.exists(fn_bam) || file.size(fn_bam) < 1000000 || params$redo) {
                f_minimap2_shortreads(fn_ref         = fn_ptDNA_noIRa,
                                      minimap_params = "-ax sr",
                                      fn_fastq_r1    = df_subset$r1_dir[1],
                                      fn_fastq_r2    = df_subset$r2_dir[1],
                                      fn_out         = fn_bam,
                                      thread         = 1,
                                      exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap,
                                      exe_samtools   = params$exe_samtools,
                                      exe_bedtools   = params$exe_bedtools)
            }
            
            # variant calling
            fn_vcf_gz <- file.path(outdir_validation_mapping, paste0(sample, ".vcf.gz"))

            if (!file.exists(fn_vcf_gz) || params$redo) {
                f_variant_calling(fn_ref       = fn_ptDNA_noIRa,
                                  fn_bam       = fn_bam,
                                  ploidy       = 1,
                                  fn_vcf       = fn_vcf_gz,
                                  exe_bcftools = params$exe_bcftools)
            }

            # generate consensus sequences
            fn_consensus <- file.path(outdir_validation_consensus, paste0(sample, ".fasta"))

            if (!file.exists(fn_consensus) || params$redo) {
                f_call_consensus(fn_ref       = fn_ptDNA_noIRa,
                                 fn_bed       = file.path(outdir_validation_mapping, paste0(sample, ".lowcov.bed")),
                                 fn_vcf       = file.path(outdir_validation_mapping, paste0(sample, ".snps.vcf.gz")),
                                 fn_consensus = fn_consensus,
                                 exe_bcftools = params$exe_bcftools)
            }
        }

        stopCluster(nwcl)

        # combine all consensus sequences into one file
        fn_all_ptDNA <- file.path(outdir_validation_tree, "all_ptDNA.fasta")
        unlink(fn_all_ptDNA)

        # iterate over samples
        for (sample in c("E_x_phylacis_ref", unique(df_metadata$sample))) {
            fn_seq <- ifelse(sample=="E_x_phylacis_ref",
                             fn_ptDNA_noIRa,
                             file.path(outdir_validation_consensus, paste0(sample, ".fasta")))

            # check if consensus sequence exists
            if (!file.exists(fn_seq)) {
                next
            }

            # update the header
            seq <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(fn_seq)
            names(seq) <- sample
            Biostrings::writeXStringSet(seq, filepath=fn_all_ptDNA, append=T)
        }

        # run IQ-TREE2
        f_iqtree2(fn_fasta    = fn_all_ptDNA,
                  thread      = params$thread,
                  exe_iqtree2 = params$exe_iqtree)
    }
}
```
